newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks seesaw, end higher in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks seesaw, end higher in choppy trade.

text.p: Madrid share indices ended higher on Tuesday after a choppy day's trade, influenced by thin volume and weakness in other markets, dealers said.
The general index added 2.84 points, 0.49 percent, to 586.56 and the Ibex rose 38.58 points, 0.58 percent, to 6,664.43.

Repsol rose 110 pesetas to 6,210 ahead of first half results due Wednesday, for which forecasts point to a net profit decline of at most nine percent. The shares were recouping after a period of weakness, traders said.

A dealer at a foreign house said final investors, probably from the U.S., were switching out of Endesa and into Iberdrola after both announced Latin American deals last week. Endesa shed 55 pesetas to 3,075 while Iberdrola gained 55 pesetas to 1,815.

"It's pretty clear there was switching from one to the other, but the surprising thing was that the Endesa offered was being taken up really well. I wouldn't expect it to weaken much further," he said.
Overall, the market is still weak and may slip further, amid concerns about rising German money rates, dealers said.
